newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES FOR DECEMBER 21-23.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES FOR DECEMBER 21-23.
